# Lab 4.12: DML: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE

## What We Are Going to Do
Use INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE, then build a full Slowly Changing Dimension Type 2 MERGE.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Basic DML.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE lab04.products (id INT64, name STRING, price NUMERIC);
INSERT INTO lab04.products VALUES (1, 'Mug', 250), (2, 'Pen', 40), (3, 'Bag', 900);
UPDATE lab04.products SET price = price * 1.1 WHERE id = 1;
DELETE FROM lab04.products WHERE price &lt; 50;
SELECT * FROM lab04.products;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Each statement shows **"This statement modified N rows"**.

2. **[SQL] Create an SCD Type 2 dimension.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE lab04.dim_product (
  id INT64, name STRING, price NUMERIC,
  valid_from TIMESTAMP, valid_to TIMESTAMP, is_current BOOL
);
INSERT INTO lab04.dim_product
SELECT id, name, price, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31', TRUE FROM lab04.products;

CREATE TABLE lab04.stg_product AS
SELECT 1 AS id, 'Mug' AS name, NUMERIC '300' AS price UNION ALL
SELECT 4, 'Lamp', NUMERIC '1200';</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] The SCD Type 2 MERGE.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">MERGE lab04.dim_product t
USING (
  SELECT id AS join_key, * FROM lab04.stg_product
  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL, s.* FROM lab04.stg_product s
  JOIN lab04.dim_product d ON s.id = d.id AND d.is_current AND s.price != d.price
) s
ON t.id = s.join_key AND t.is_current
WHEN MATCHED AND t.price != s.price THEN
  UPDATE SET valid_to = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), is_current = FALSE
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
  INSERT (id, name, price, valid_from, valid_to, is_current)
  VALUES (s.id, s.name, s.price, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31', TRUE);

SELECT * FROM lab04.dim_product ORDER BY id, valid_from;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The Mug now has two rows: the old price (closed) and the new price (current). The Lamp is a new current row.

bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
'SELECT statement_type, dml_statistics FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_USER
 WHERE statement_type IN ("INSERT","UPDATE","DELETE","MERGE","TRUNCATE_TABLE")
 ORDER BY creation_time DESC LIMIT 5'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| DML | Modified-row counts shown |
| SCD2 MERGE | Old row closed, new row current |
| New product | Inserted as current |
| `dml_statistics` | Inserted, updated and deleted row counts |
